title: e-boost: Boosted E-Graph Extraction with Adaptive Heuristics and Exact Solving
problem: E-graph extraction for circuit synthesis requires expensive ILP solving. Existing methods are computationally limited and do not scale well.
motivation: Faster e-graph extraction enables quicker circuit optimization and synthesis; accelerating this bottleneck improves design productivity.
method: Hybrid framework combining parallelized heuristics, adaptive pruning strategies, and ILP solving. Heuristics generate candidates; ILP refines optimal solutions. Achieves 558× speedup over pure ILP; 7.6-8.1% area improvement in synthesized circuits.
key_novelty: Adaptive pruning combined with parallel heuristics and ILP for accelerated e-graph extraction with improved synthesis quality.
limitations: Applicability to diverse circuit types and comparison with other synthesis frameworks limited by abstract-only analysis.
